primary_claim: Under defined degraded-connectivity conditions, twin-informed service-aware orchestration reduces service outage or recovery time relative to static, network-only, and service-priority policies while respecting energy, fairness, privacy, and reliability constraints.

definition.start_event: first_unavailable_sample (latency_ms null OR probe_timeout in quality_flags OR service_available==false)
definition.timeout_behavior: if unrecovered by session end, censor at last sample timestamp
definition.censored_session_behavior: include censored duration in session total; flag censored=true
definition.failure_behavior: value=null only when measurements empty or timestamps invalid
definition.unavailable_data_behavior: null metrics remain null; probe_timeout marks unavailable
definition.session_summary: sum of outage recovery intervals within the session

rationale: recovery_time_s is computed from frozen edge_measurement_batch.v1 fields (timestamp, latency_ms, quality_flags) via scripts/compute_recovery_time.py. This is directly measurable without inventing composites. Model expected_recovery_time_s remains secondary/analysis-only.
amendment_policy: Preserve original lock file under evaluation/amendments/; record reason, prior SHA, new SHA; never silently rewrite history.
